description: #764: enclosing symbols also list references from changed files (marked changed_file) after unchanged-file ones, skipping their own declaration line and every added line: the same-file caller shape of #547 (get_cached_jwt -> fetch_integration_jwt, resolve_auth_header -> get_cached_jwt), a pre-existing caller in the changed test file (the added test's calls are filtered), and the per-symbol changed-reference cap (reference_cap). Non-test changed files are searched before test files, so the test file's many fetch_integration_jwt calls (which sort first by path) cannot crowd out the production callers in src/jwt_cache.py and src/worker.py. An added declaration (build_headers) referenced only from a changed file renders 'references only in changed files'; one with no other reference (jwt_ttl_seconds) still renders 'no references'. Anchors are the real change_anchors output for source_diff over repo_files.

repo_files.src/__tests__/test_jwt_cache.py:
from src import jwt_cache


def test_get_cached_jwt_uses_cache():
    jwt_cache._JWT_CACHE["jwt"] = "x"
    assert jwt_cache.get_cached_jwt() == "x"


def test_fetch_integration_jwt_many():
    for _ in range(2):
        jwt_cache.fetch_integration_jwt()
    jwt_cache.fetch_integration_jwt()
    jwt_cache.fetch_integration_jwt()
    jwt_cache.fetch_integration_jwt()
    jwt_cache.fetch_integration_jwt()
    assert jwt_cache.fetch_integration_jwt() == "abc"


def test_concurrent_cache_reads():
    assert jwt_cache.get_cached_jwt() == jwt_cache.get_cached_jwt()
